summary: A flip-book of full-screen photographs with live editable type on them: each page is a real street scene whose type block is contenteditable with a per-box font menu, and arrows move to the next page. Only the first page was captured; the rest (vote.html…) is not in the archive.

instances.look: Full-bleed photo of a yellow wall with a birch-forest mural door; 'Aspen' in Black on the door and four lines of italic text aligned to the door panel
instances.ux: The copy tells you what to do: click text to edit, use arrows to flip; a right arrow sits bottom-right
instances.learn: Choose a photo with a flat framed area, and place the type in it so it looks painted on the scene

reconstruction.layout: Photo 3000×1800 scaled to cover (1500×900 at 1440, left -60px, centred at x=0.53). Name ~420px wide inside the green panel, top ~110px; paragraph centred below
reconstruction.typography: 'Aspen' ~230px Aspen Black, rgba(255,255,255,.8); paragraph ~33px Aspen Italic, centred, leading ~1.25
reconstruction.behaviour: Image resizes to cover keeping data-center; text scale follows the image; mobile keeps the image wide and crops the text
reconstruction.content: 'Explore this refreshing and resilient typeface. Click on any text to edit it. Use the arrows at the bottom of the site to flip through the pages.'

instances.look: Each text box on the photo darkens on hover with a white 'Click to Edit' pill; clicking opens a font menu for that box (hidden select dropdowns, not in the capture)
instances.feel: Editing a poster in a mock-up, not filling a form
instances.ux: Hover box, click, type; the menu has font family (18 styles), size 100-800, alignment, line height, text colour, reset, alternates and figure feature checkboxes, plus share buttons
instances.learn: Put the tester inside a real picture: with per-box controls the visitor makes a shareable poster from the specimen

reconstruction.layout: Absolutely placed .textbox over the image at image-relative coordinates; hover overlay rgba(0,0,0,.4); pill centred, ~60px wide, radius 6px, 10px black on white
reconstruction.typography: Each box sets its defaults through data-fontmenu: font-size default 500 (image px), min 100, max 800, Aspen Black
reconstruction.behaviour: jquery.fontselect dropdowns; feature sets 'set1' (Roman) / 'set2' (Italic) swap per style: ss01 Alternate a, ss02 Alternate g, tnum, lnum, sups, subs, zero; Facebook, Twitter and Download buttons at bottom left share or save the composed image
reconstruction.content: The editable copy is the site's instructions

instances.look: A round translucent white arrow button fixed bottom-right, linking to the next page; attached to the screen block, never cut on its own
instances.ux: Click goes to vote.html; left-side round buttons appear for share and download
instances.learn: One round arrow turns a set of photo pages into a flip-book

reconstruction.layout: ~40px circle at bottom-right, 20px inset, position fixed
reconstruction.behaviour: Plain link to the next HTML page
